items.statement: The migration coverage maps all Decision_Log source spans into atomized units, retired lineage, or structural dispositions while explicitly avoiding Spec Lock/governance artifact refresh and executable build artifacts.

evidence.exact_quote: All original spans from `Decision_Log-S0001` through `Decision_Log-S0026` are preserved in place. dimension_assessments.summary: Identity migration, corroboration outcomes, alias limits, retained cleanup, and retired-lineage prohibitions are explicit, with implementation gaps separately identified.
The help-cluster capability and governance-decision surfacing capability are stated.
Corroboration outcomes are stated, but voter/input qualification and advisory payloads are missing; approval command payload mapping is also incomplete.
Anchor fields, aliases, and DecisionRecord fields are named, but payload, schema, alias resolution, and compatibility contracts remain incomplete.
Entry into retained is defined, but reevaluation, release, precedence, and terminal transition behavior are absent.
Runtime graph authority is explicit, but manual retention authority and governance-record viewing authority are not.
Owner documents, owner hints, implementation surfaces, and runtime graph-state ownership are explicitly represented.
Implementation and owner surfaces identify the principal plan consumers and the Orchestrator GUI consumer.
Orchestrator advisory visibility and the Governance Decisions route are stated, but help navigation rendering and DecisionRecord authorization/presentation remain under-specified.
Compatibility failures, corroboration abstentions/errors, broken help links, and stale retained-state recovery are not defined.
Governance records and approval commands have no stated read/command authorization or rationale-reference privacy handling.
Dependency, unblock, implementation-surface, migration, and no-governance-refresh boundaries are explicit.
Migration proof artifacts and plan validators are identified, but runtime operational handling and executable receipts are absent.
The assigned core specifies decision, migration, identity, help, and lifecycle semantics without defining a workload or performance-sensitive algorithm; no scale claim is made.
Retired lineage and migration boundaries are strong, but the request-centric to blocked-episode compatibility mapping is not executable or complete.
Plan migration/index validators exist, but no behavioral oracle proves the product semantics in this window.
Consequential discretion remains in approval payloads, corroboration inputs, help navigation, retention lifecycle, record schema, security, and behavioral tests.
The DecisionRecord repair row has a direct unresolved status contradiction, alongside the identified contract ambiguities.
